content.text: All preferred elements are satisfied in § 8. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Section 8.2 provides automatic renewals of successive twelve-month periods (no multi-year renewal), a Customer non-renewal notice window of only thirty days (within the preferred 30-day ceiling and well inside the fallback 60 days), and an express Vendor reminder obligation at least sixty days before renewal, reinforced by an extension of Customer's opt-out deadline if the reminder is not sent. Section 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of US CPI-U over the preceding twelve months and three percent, with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods. This meets every preferred atomic element, so the conditional automatic-renewal path applies and mutual written agreement is not required. No redline needed.

mappings.element: Renewal requires mutual written agreement unless every conditional automatic-renewal element below is met.
mappings.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, each renewal term is no longer than 12 months.
mappings.quote: thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer may opt out on no more than 30 days' notice.
mappings.quote: unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Vendor must remind Customer at least 60 days before renewal.

mappings.element: If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at the lesser of CPI and 3 percent.
mappings.quote: 8.3 On renewal, Vendor may increase recurring Fees only by the lesser of the increase in the United States Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers during the preceding twelve months and three percent.
